problem:
$$
[\begin{aligned}a & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & b & 0 \\ 2 & 1 & c\end{aligned}]
$$

The matrix of the bilinear form $B(x,y)={x}_{1}{y}_{1}+2{x}_{2}{y}_{2}+2{x}_{3}{y}_{1}+{x}_{3}{y}_{2}-3{x}_{3}{y}_{3}$ is given above. What is the value of $a+b+c?$

feedback.problem:
$$
[\begin{aligned}a & \,\,-2 \\ 0 & b\end{aligned}]
$$

The matrix of the bilinear form $B(x,y)={x}_{1}{y}_{1}-2{x}_{1}{y}_{2}+2{x}_{2}{y}_{2}$ is given above. What is the value of $a+b?$
feedback.worked_solution:
Each term ${a}_{ij}{x}_{i}{y}_{j}$ in the expression of the bilinear form corresponds to the entry ${a}_{ij}$ of the matrix:

$$
\begin{aligned}B(x,y) & ={x}_{1}{y}_{1}-2{x}_{1}{y}_{2}+2{x}_{2}{y}_{2} \\  & =1{x}_{1}{y}_{1}+(-2){x}_{1}{y}_{2} \\  & +\,0{x}_{2}{y}_{1}\,+2{x}_{2}{y}_{2}\end{aligned}
$$

 

Then, the corresponding matrix of the bilinear form is

$$
[\begin{aligned}1 & \,\,-2 \\ 0 & 2\end{aligned}].
$$

Therefore, $a=1$ and $b=2.$ Finally, 

$$
a+b=1+2=3.
$$
